note: Re-judged after the reactor gained TestRFC6996ExportRemovesPrivateUseASNsFromASPath. Positive: the plugin units draw the as-path remove "private" intent for 64512, 65534, 4200000000 and 4294967294 (AS_PATH, and AS4_PATH behind AS_TRANS); the new reactor unit sends that intent from an external filter through the export step toward an EBGP peer and asserts the exact UPDATE body, AS_PATH [64511 64512 65534 65535 4199999999 4200000000 4294967294 4294967295] becoming [64511 65535 4199999999 4294967295] (every range edge removed, every neighbour kept); TestRFC6996StripRemovesPrivateUseASNsFromAS4Path asserts the exact AS4_PATH rewrite. Negative: plugin units withhold the intent for 64511, 65535, 4199999999 and 4294967295, and the reactor AS4_PATH negative asserts zero ops. The earlier gap is closed: a reactor that stopped rewriting AS_PATH (revert record on filter_delta.go rewriteASPathRemovePrivate) or a policychain that dropped the intent turns the new unit red. Section 4 text read in rfc/full/rfc6996.txt: "Private Use ASNs MUST be removed from AS path attributes (including AS4_PATH if utilizing a four-octet AS number space) before being advertised to the global Internet."
